facts: JanusDDG is a machine learning model developed by researchers at the University of Turin.
The model predicts protein stability changes (ΔΔG) from amino acid sequences.
JanusDDG employs a two-fronts multi-head attention mechanism.
The model is designed to be thermodynamically compliant.
JanusDDG is a deep learning framework that predicts protein stability changes (ΔΔG) from mutations.
The model uses a bidirectional cross-attention transformer architecture.
JanusDDG respects fundamental thermodynamic properties such as antisymmetry and transitivity.
Experimental results show that JanusDDG achieves state-of-the-art performance in predicting ΔΔG from sequence alone.
Protein stability is measured by the change in Gibbs free energy (ΔΔG).
JanusDDG is a deep learning model that predicts ΔΔG values using only amino acid sequences.
JanusDDG can handle multi-mutations, unlike existing methods that are limited to single or double mutations.
The model enforces antisymmetry and transitivity through tailored loss functions.
JanusDDG is a sequence-based model for predicting protein stability changes (ΔΔG) from mutations.
The model integrates delta between wild-type and mutant sequences using bidirectional cross-attention.
JanusDDG respects thermodynamic principles such as antisymmetry and transitivity through a Siamese architecture.
The model was evaluated on benchmark datasets including S669, S461, S96, PTmut-NR, and PTmul-D.
JanusDDG is a sequence-based deep learning model that predicts protein stability changes upon mutation.
JanusDDG integrates protein language model embeddings with a bidirectional cross-attention architecture.
Benchmarking shows that JanusDDG matches or outperforms existing sequence-based and structure-informed predictors.
The model effectively generalizes to multiple mutation prediction, an area where many current models are limited.
JanusDDG is a deep learning model for predicting protein stability changes (ΔΔG) upon mutation.
The model was evaluated using blind test sets with low sequence similarity (<25%) to training data.
JanusDDG integrates ESM2 protein language model embeddings with a Bidirectional Cross-Attention Transformer.
The research addresses applications in precision medicine and therapeutic design.
The fine-tuned variant of JanusDDG achieves a PCC of 0.83 on the S461 single-point test set.
The antisymmetric model of JanusDDG maintains symmetry properties with an rd-r of -1.
JanusDDG achieves a PCC of 0.84 and RMSE of 0.85 on the Ssym dataset.
On the Q3421 dataset, JanusDDG leads with an MSE of 2.10 and accuracy of 0.78.
